summary: Obsidian Energy filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer report) with a news release updating its 2026 capital program and guidance. The company increased its 2026 capital budget by ~$100 million to $300-$325 million, targeting ~15% production growth in 2027, with incremental investment directed to Belly River and Cardium development and Peace River waterflood expansion. No special-situation M&A, activist, restructuring, or other event-driven category applies; this is a routine operational update filed as a 6-K.
